# The tools

**Generated by `python tools/index.py`. Do not edit by hand.** Each entry is the
script's own first line, so a wrong entry is a wrong docstring and belongs in the
script.

`tools/requirements.txt` covers what these need. Anything reading the original resolves
its path through `reference.py`, which reads the git-ignored `reccmp-user.yml`, so no
script here carries anybody's disk layout.

## Build, score and gate

What the build and the score run, in the order they run it.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `cmake_build.py` | Run `cmake --build` and run it again when NMake stops with U1054. |
| `reference.py` | Where the original executable lives. |
| `extract_resources.py` | Read the resource directory out of the user's own copy of the original and write a .res. |
| `stamp.py` | Patch the COFF TimeDateStamp of a built image to the original's link time. |
| `richcheck.py` | Report the Rich header of a built image and compare its toolchain against the original. |
| `pecompare.py` | Compare a built image against the original and report the first difference. |
| `rsrccompare.py` | Compare the built .rsrc section against the original's, byte for byte. |
| `report.py` | The one place that opens build/report.json, and the one place that says when it is stale. |
| `progress.py` | Measure how much of the original this project reproduces, by bytes. |
| `check_regressions.py` | Compares the current report against a saved baseline and names what stopped matching. |
| `check_readme.py` | Reports a README whose status figures no longer match the report. |
| `checkers.py` | Run every structural checker and print one line each. |
| `check_battery_bites.py` | Checks that each checker in the battery still reports the fault it was written for. |

## Checkers

Run by CI, by the `verify` build targets, or by `checkers.py`. Each fails on one fault and says which.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `base_reads_derived.py` | Fail when a base's own member reads an offset one of its derived classes declares. |
| `base_this_casts.py` | Find casts of `this` to a class the enclosing class already derives from. |
| `blob_rivals.py` | Finds files that name a record's offsets differently from the class that covers them. |
| `check_asm_bodies.py` | Check inline assembly and naked routines against the register of original assembly. |
| `check_balance.py` | Fail on a source file whose brackets do not balance. |
| `check_body_reach.py` | Fail when a marked body reads at or past the end of its own class. |
| `check_call_arity.py` | Check every written __cdecl signature against the argument count its callers push. |
| `check_cast_width.py` | Find `*(T*)&x->field` where T is a different width than the field it reaches. |
| `check_chained_casts.py` | Counts pointer casts applied to pointer casts. |
| `check_class_struct_keyword.py` | Find types spelled `class` in one file and `struct` in another. |
| `check_conventions.py` | Find declarations whose calling convention disagrees with the original's code. |
| `check_datavalues.py` | Fails when a global's value stops agreeing with the original's. |
| `check_dead_defines.py` | Finds a numeric #define in a .cpp that nothing in that file reads. |
| `check_dead_stores.py` | Fail on two consecutive writes to one name where the first cannot be read. |
| `check_dead_this_alias.py` | Report an alias of `this` that its own function never reads. |
| `check_declaration_style.py` | Checks two declaration rules: one name per declaration, and no alternative operator tokens. |
| `check_discarded_types.py` | Find char* locals assigned from something whose type is already declared. |
| `check_doc_paths.py` | Check every repository path a document names, and report the ones that no longer exist. |
| `check_doubled_file_names.py` | Report a comment naming one file on both sides of an "and". |
| `check_dtor_calls.py` | Fail on an explicit destructor call that is not qualified with its class. |
| `check_duplicate_constants.py` | Reports a #define that spells one fact in several files at once. |
| `check_duplicated_prose.py` | Find a run of comment lines written twice inside one note. |
| `check_explicit_ctors.py` | Find single-argument constructors that are not `explicit`. |
| `check_extern_bounds.py` | Report an `extern` array in src whose first dimension has no bound. |
| `check_field_offsets.py` | Fail when a class's declared field offsets go backwards. |
| `check_field_tiling.py` | Fail when a class's declared fields leave a hole or overlap. |
| `check_folded.py` | Report identical-code folding in the measured build, and annotations that disagree about it. |
| `check_functions.py` | Report an address given more than one FUNCTION, STUB or LIBRARY marker. |
| `check_ghost_forwards.py` | Fails on a `class X;` forward declaration for an X this tree never defines. |
| `check_globals.py` | Report GLOBAL markers that name one address twice, or that overlap each other. |
| `check_id_notes.py` | Find plan handler id notes that sit on another handler's body. |
| `check_include_hygiene.py` | Fails on three include faults a build does not report clearly. |
| `check_ledger_figures.py` | Report a ledger row whose recorded score the report no longer gives. |
| `check_link_order.py` | Fail when a marked `$E` thunk pairs with another unit's thunk, or with the wrong thunk of its own. |
| `check_lint.py` | Run reccmp's annotation linter and fail on everything except the one rule this tree rejects. |
| `check_lost_markers.py` | Report reccmp markers that were in HEAD and are no longer anywhere under src. |
| `check_macro_enum_clash.py` | Finds an enumerator that another file also defines as a macro. |
| `check_marker_comments.py` | Report markers that are not followed by the thing they annotate. |
| `check_marker_prefix.py` | Catch a marker whose comment prefix reccmp will not parse. |
| `check_member_owner.py` | Fail when a member function sits on a class the image's tables do not put it on. |
| `check_mixed_units.py` | Flags a statement that steps pointers by the same literal in both byte and element units. |
| `check_named_addresses.py` | Find comments that name a function at an address where the FUNCTION marker names another. |
| `check_note_scars.py` | Find a bare `//` that opens a note, closes one, or stands next to another. |
| `check_null_test_casts.py` | Fails on a cast applied to a name that is then compared straight against zero. |
| `check_parser_alerts.py` | Report files whose annotations reccmp's own parser rejects. |
| `check_prefixed_functions.py` | Report a `Name__Function` in src: a class or namespace spelled into a free function's name. |
| `check_record_arith.py` | Fail on byte arithmetic done through a pointer to a record. |
| `check_redundant_forwards.py` | Finds a forward declaration in a .cpp for a class an include above it already defines. |
| `check_restated_externs.py` | Report a `.cpp` extern that restates one a header it includes already declares, with no reason. |
| `check_retired.py` | Guard the retirement registers against duplicates and stale names. |
| `check_scaled_offsets.py` | Flag a byte offset added to a pointer that is not byte-sized. |
| `check_score_prose.py` | Report a source comment that records match history instead of describing the code. |
| `check_self_assign.py` | Fail on a statement that assigns something to itself. |
| `check_self_casts.py` | Fail on a member function that casts `this` to its own class, or to a view class. |
| `check_self_naming_notes.py` | Find comments that name the file they are written in. |
| `check_shrinkage.py` | Report tracked files that lost most of their content since HEAD. |
| `check_slot_arity.py` | Check every class against the slot arities its own table carries in the image. |
| `check_source_paths.py` | Report a comment in src/ that names a file path the tree does not have. |
| `check_stray_sources.py` | Find source files under src/ that git does not track, or that sit at the top of src/. |
| `check_tables_named.py` | Fail when a vtable in the image has no class in this tree. |
| `check_unassigned_locals.py` | Find a local pointer that is read but never written, which compiles and is wrong. |
| `check_undefined_members.py` | Report a member function declared in a header, defined nowhere, with no comment saying why. |
| `check_vararg_calls.py` | Report GameApp::Error and GameApp::Fatal calls whose format string wants arguments and gets none. |
| `check_virtual_bodies.py` | Fail when a class declares a virtual it never defines. |
| `check_volatile.py` | Report a `volatile` in the source with no reason written beside it. |
| `check_vptr_offsets.py` | Fail when a polymorphic class declares a field at an offset the vptr already holds. |
| `check_vtable_arity_declared.py` | Compare each class's declared virtual count against the length of the table it names. |
| `check_vtables.py` | Fails when a vtable that used to pair against the original stops pairing. |
| `check_vtbl_stores.py` | Fail when a member stores a `g_vtbl` array that is not its own class's table. |
| `const_accessors.py` | Find member functions whose whole body is one return of a member, and which are not const. |
| `const_locals.py` | Fails on a local that is initialised once, never written again, and not declared const. |
| `dead_defines.py` | Find, and optionally delete, offset defines that nothing uses. |
| `duplicate_markers.py` | Find one original address claimed by more than one annotation. |
| `enum_names.py` | Fail when an id the tree names disagrees with the developers' name, from ENUMIDS.H or a cache. |
| `header_homes.py` | Reports which header defines each class, and whether that header is named after it. |
| `implicit_narrowing.py` | Lists integer assignments that narrow a value without an explicit cast. |
| `kind_names.py` | Compare every name the tree gives an object kind with the name the client gives it. |
| `marker_next_line.py` | Find reccmp markers whose name is not the declaration on the line under them. |
| `namespace_spread.py` | Counts the classes and namespaces whose bodies sit in more than one .cpp, or in no .cpp named for them. |
| `placeholder_functions.py` | Lists functions and methods whose name is a placeholder, with their callers and what each touches. |
| `placeholder_globals.py` | Lists globals whose name gives only their address, with the functions that read and write each. |
| `plan_dump.py` | Print a compiled plan file as indented pseudo-source, every id named from ENUMIDS.H. |
| `plan_names.py` | Fail when a plan function's name is not the developers' for its id, from ENUMIDS.H or a cache. |
| `publish_ghidra.py` | Push everything this repository knows into your own Ghidra database. |
| `redundant_return_casts.py` | Finds a cast of a call's result to the type that call already returns, pointer or scalar. |
| `rival_names.py` | Find offsets that a header names one thing and a .cpp's #define names another. |
| `self_type_casts.py` | Find casts of a variable to the type it is already declared as. |
| `shared_reserves.py` | Find bytes that several classes over one base each reserve for themselves. |
| `unused_includes.py` | Finds an `#include` whose header introduces no name the including file writes. |
| `unused_params.py` | Finds a parameter the body never names and no `(void)` cast admits. |
| `view_classes.py` | Find classes that are the same class declared twice. |
| `x87_precision.py` | Heuristic: find rows where this build rounds an x87 value through memory and the client does not, or the reverse. |

## Other checkers

Checks you run by hand. Some need the game data, the Ghidra bridge or a bring-up run.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `check_arenas.py` | Play every arena and fail when one of them stops drawing its scene. |
| `check_battery_reach.py` | Counts how many of the tree's source files each checker in the battery actually opens. |
| `check_doc_figures.py` | Check every number docs/RE_CRUFT.md puts in bold against the output of the tool that row names. |
| `check_headers_standalone.py` | Check that each header compiles on its own, with nothing included before it. |
| `check_initialised_globals.py` | Find globals the image gives a value and this tree leaves at zero. |
| `check_marker_errors.py` | Reads the marker errors reccmp prints and fails on the ones that are claims about the binary. |
| `check_markers_resolve.py` | Reports markers reccmp cannot resolve, and markers whose kind disagrees with the address. |
| `check_match.py` | Play one match and fail when the things a match is supposed to do stop happening. |
| `check_member_name_collisions.py` | List member names that more than one class declares. |
| `check_model_files.py` | Walk every .WBM the way ModelComponent::ReadAll does, and name the ones that run short. |
| `check_named_offsets.py` | Find `+ 0xNN` computed on a pointer whose own class already declares a field at 0xNN. |
| `check_row_sizes.py` | Check every inventory size against the number of bytes reccmp actually compared. |
| `check_screens.py` | Walk to every menu state and fail when a screen stops drawing. |
| `check_short_arrays.py` | Find array globals declared shorter than the storage the image gives them. |

## Searches over the original

Ask a question of the reference image and print what it finds.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `find_inlined_calls.py` | List calls the original makes that this build inlines instead. |
| `find_unoptimised.py` | List functions the original built without optimisation. |

## Naming

Propose names for what the original has and this tree does not. A proposal is not an answer: apply it, rescore, and drop what does not reach 100.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `name_at.py` | Say what this tree calls the globals and functions a range of the image touches. |

## Bring-up

Drive the bring-up build, which runs the game. Never measure that build.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `bringup_check.py` | Compares a bring-up sweep against a local baseline and names the states that broke. |
| `bringup_run.py` | Build the bring-up copy, run it for a fixed number of frames, and report what it did. |
| `bringup_sweep.py` | Run every engine state through the bring-up binary and report the three signals. |
| `bringup_where.py` | Name the function a bring-up crash address falls in. |

## The v1.0.0.0 frame-pointer tables

v1.0.0.0 ships an unstripped debug directory. These read it and carry what it knows across to v1.0.0.1.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `fpo_anchors.py` | Anchor v1.0.0.0 functions to their named v1.0.0.1 counterparts through string literals. |
| `fpo_arity.py` | Compare v1.0.0.0's recorded parameter size against this project's signatures. |
| `fpo_propagate.py` | Grow the v1.0.0.0 to v1.0.0.1 anchor set along the call graph. |
| `fpo_table.py` | Read the FPO function table out of HYPERX.EXE v1.0.0.0. |

## Everything else

One-offs, readers and diagnostics. Most are run by hand with an address.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `alloc_weight.py` | Measure how much one reference weighs in VC6's callee-saved register ranking. |
| `blob_locals.py` | Split raw-offset `char*` locals into those a class already covers and those that need a decode. |
| `bmp_to_png.py` | Turn a bring-up snapshot into a PNG, so it can be looked at without another tool. |
| `claims.py` | Say what already claims an address, before a new function is written against it. |
| `class_files.py` | List the class each .cpp file defines bodies for. |
| `class_spread.py` | Lists classes whose bodies are spread over more than one .cpp, and whether each split is settled. |
| `comments.py` | Blank the comments out of C++ source, keeping every offset, for tools that grep code. |
| `extract_mdm1.py` | Unpack the game's MDM1-packed bitmaps into ordinary BMP files, and PNG with --png. |
| `extract_rc.py` | Write the original's resources out as a readable .rc script, with its icons as .ico files. |
| `fault_classes.py` | Sorts the rows that are not exact by the cause of their difference rather than by score. |
| `field_names.py` | Rewrite byte-offset reads of a class's own fields as the field names. |
| `fix_row_extents.py` | Give every matching row the extent reccmp actually compared, and drop what that swallows. |
| `fixincludes.py` | Builds, and adds the missing include to each failing file until the build passes. |
| `frame.py` | Canonical frame slots for one function, on either side, as a map you can diff. |
| `frame_search.py` | Search an /Od function's local names for the frame map the client has. |
| `gap_shape.py` | Split the remaining accuracy by the shape of each row's difference. |
| `ghidra_api.py` | Thin wrapper over the GhidraMCP HTTP bridge. |
| `global_drift.py` | Measure how far each annotated global sits from the address the client puts it at. |
| `global_fields.py` | Name the offsets a body reaches through a typed global. |
| `image_tables.py` | Read the reference image's sections, and the vtable addresses this tree names. |
| `int_pointer_params.py` | Lists parameters declared `int` or `void*` whose own body casts them back to a pointer. |
| `layout_twins.py` | Find classes that declare the same bytes as another class without deriving from it. |
| `lost_pragmas.py` | Name the bodies a move, merge or sort put under different pragmas from the ones they had. |
| `misplaced_notes.py` | Find a note above a marked body that describes a different body. |
| `missing_this.py` | Finds functions whose diff is missing an object load the client has. |
| `movefn.py` | Moves marked definitions from one source file to another, in address order. |
| `near_misses.py` | Ranks unfinished functions by what closing them is worth, not by how far off they are. |
| `object_sizes.py` | Read how many bytes the client allocates for each class, and say which of ours disagree. |
| `offset_reads.py` | Classify `*(T*)((char*)p + N)` reads, the blob's shape on a pointer that is not `this`. |
| `operand_residue.py` | Find the rows whose residue is operand naming, not instruction bytes. |
| `param_aliases.py` | Finds a local that only gives a parameter a second name: `PlanNode* const pPlan = pNode;` |
| `param_fields.py` | Name the offsets a body reaches through a typed pointer that is not `this`. |
| `peinfo.py` | Minimal PE, COFF and archive readers shared by the verification tools. |
| `placeholder_fields.py` | Lists members whose name gives only their offset, ranked by how many use sites they have. |
| `plan_graph.py` | Decode a compiled plan file into named behaviours, messages and actions. |
| `plan_tables.py` | The plan handler registrations in src/planvm/planvm.cpp, with their indices resolved. |
| `pointer_puns.py` | Counts `*(int*)&X` puns where X is a pointer or a four byte integer, the cases that are cruft. |
| `pragmas.py` | The compiler pragma state a source file puts in force at each line, for the tools that move bodies. |
| `prior_work.py` | Reports everything already written down about an address, before you open it. |
| `probe_asm.py` | Compile one source file to a `/FAs` listing with the build's own flags. |
| `prove_neutral.py` | Prove a change moved no bytes, by holding every row against a snapshot taken before it. |
| `pull_functions.py` | Refresh the names in symbols/functions.csv from Ghidra. |
| `ready_unwritten.py` | Rank the functions nobody has written yet by how much of what they call already exists. |
| `residue_kinds.py` | Split a row's residue into register or constant naming and a different instruction stream. |
| `scattered_records.py` | Find globals the original reads as one record and this tree declares as separate variables. |
| `self_fields.py` | Name the offsets a class reaches in its own members, composites included. |
| `settled.py` | Tell a survey tool whether a declaration's note says the change was already declined. |
| `short_ports.py` | Lists functions reccmp scores over a prefix because this build is shorter. |
| `show_class.py` | Print every declaration of a class, so the views of one object can be read side by side. |
| `slot_owners.py` | Say which slots a class overrides, and who owns each overriding body today. |
| `slot_residue.py` | Rank open rows by how much of their residue is a frame-slot displacement fault. |
| `staleness.py` | Find sources newer than the linked image, or a report older than it. |
| `status.py` | Displays status across matching, clean-up and bring-up. |
| `status_card.py` | Draw progress/status.svg, the status card, from build/report.json. |
| `table_content.py` | Verify a dispatch table's content against the original, slot by slot. |
| `this_casts.py` | Report every member that casts `this` to a class it has no relation to. |
| `undeclared_reads.py` | Rank classes by the bytes their own members reach and the class never declares. |
| `undecoded_views.py` | Find records whose first member is a byte run, which is a view rather than a decode. |
| `unresolved_calls.py` | Find call targets the client's side has no annotation for. |
| `untyped_globals.py` | Surveys how the tree uses each `void*` and `char*` global, to find which can be retyped. |
| `untyped_members.py` | Report the types the tree casts each `void*` and `char*` member to. |
| `vtable_behaviour.py` | Count vtable slots that run a different body from the original's. |
| `vtable_forest.py` | Recover the class hierarchy from HYPERX.EXE's own vtables. |
| `vtable_slots.py` | Find vtable slots whose body the tree files under a class that cannot reach them. |
